Subject: the TWO opposed original side hammerhead halves, which together form ONE detachable factory component. Preserve the empty central mounting gap shown in image 2. Enlarge the entire pair uniformly to approximately 75 percent of inner circle width. Preserve actual carving design. No central mount, shaft, joining block, extra halves or rearrangement.
